title: The Extended African Comparative Wordlist (EACW)
description:
The Extended African Comparative Wordlist (EACW): a digital lexical organization system for field linguists. A comparative wordlist and system of lexical reference with 2,556 items in nineteen semantic sections, 2,274 of which make up its default list. Every item has a meaningful reference (C001f 'mother': C for kinship, 001 for 'parent', f for female), a default word class, a clarification where the gloss needs one, a taxon for animals and plants, a regional code, and its numbers in the SIL Comparative African Wordlist (CAWL) and the Swadesh list.

Tab-separated files: eacw.tsv (the list), cawl.tsv and swadesh.tsv (the correspondences; the CAWL's own glosses are not included). The list is maintained in dated editions; EDITIONS.md records what each one changed.
